points: Micah had a whole house of gods. He made an ephod and teraphim and consecrated one of his own sons to be his priest, a counterfeit priesthood serving counterfeit gods.

note.label: Judges 17: Micah's House of Idols and the Hired Levite

points: A young Levite of Bethlehemjudah departed to sojourn wherever he could find a place and came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah.

note.label: Judges 17: Micah's House of Idols and the Hired Levite

points: When Micah learned the man was a Levite, of the tribe known for the priesthood and the knowledge of the sacrifices, he offered him a deal: dwell with me, be unto me a father and a priest, ten shekels of silver by the year, a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. He hired himself a personal priest for his idols.

note.label: Judges 17: Micah's House of Idols and the Hired Levite

points: Then Micah said, now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest. A house full of idols and a hired priest over them, yet he expected the Most High to bless him because a Levite was on the payroll. That is how sick in the mind Israel was without leadership.

note.label: Judges 17: Micah's House of Idols and the Hired Levite

points: The children of Dan sent five men of valour from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out land to conquer, and on their way they came to mount Ephraim and lodged at the house of Micah.

note.label: Judges 18: Dan Steals Micah's Gods and Takes Laish

points: By the house of Micah they knew the voice of the young man the Levite, and they turned in and questioned him: who brought thee hither? what makest thou in this place? A Levite serving in a house of idols raised questions.

note.label: Judges 18: Dan Steals Micah's Gods and Takes Laish

points: When Micah and the men near his house gathered and overtook the children of Dan, Dan asked, what aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company? He answered, ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more?

note.label: Judges 18: Dan Steals Micah's Gods and Takes Laish

points: The Danites took the things which Micah had made and the priest which he had, came unto Laish, unto a people quiet and secure, smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.
